mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing output and economic activity, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of post-recession recovery periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in residential demand that reduces construction sector activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 600.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve's tightening response leads to reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in this regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently indicates a tightening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a shift in consumer spending patterns toward durable goods, which correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS declines and HOUST rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02.
